purpose: Compare fixed implemented baselines with subsequently disclosed report-date holdings and the original PPT error definitions
industry_labels: complete reconciled June/December holdings; historical SW2021 membership; A-share NAV weights
stock_labels: independent quarterly asset allocation stock NAV ratio
tuning: none; freeze both current baselines before expanding samples
universe: all historically eligible products present in AlphaDB metadata, with share families merged; include every eligible product in coverage denominator

input_modes.recorded_ann_date: Use original verified announcement dates; historical contract defaults remain explicitly conditional
input_modes.nav_date_assumption: Sensitivity only: NAV marked available the next calendar day; remove any late-announced AUM on the changed rows; holdings announcements unchanged

primary_error: sum_i abs(estimated_NAV_weight_i - actual_NAV_weight_i), i in 31 SW2021 A-share industries
threshold_status: user-suggested diagnostic reference, not a replacement for the original model promotion protocol
label_policy: Missing truth or incomplete mapping is excluded explicitly, never zero filled. Later labels never enter estimation inputs.
holdout: 2025-2026H1 remains unopened because the formal selection and data gates have not passed
end_reason: Last half-year endpoint with the existing dated bond and RMB HK benchmark supplement, which ends 2024-07-19
history_kind: announcement_date_reconstruction; no historical vendor revision archive
